omnibuses.title: The Monstrous Beloved Volume I
omnibuses.blurb: Books one through three collected together: three sapphic monster romances, three Registry failures, and the first cracks in the official record.

omnibuses.title: The Monstrous Beloved Volume II
omnibuses.blurb: Books four through six collected together: stranger bargains, deeper Registry pressure, and the end of the thread the institution tried to bury.
